Fictional insurer opens rural review

Fictional Pine County officials began a review of rural insurance access after three clinics reported longer appointment waits this spring.

The review will compare network directories with clinic schedules and ask residents whether listed providers accept new patients.

State staff plan to publish a summary in September and invite insurers to correct outdated directory information before renewal season.

Fictional commissioner Lee said the review will give families a clearer picture of available care.
